title: Atheroma Quantification in Mice
author: Amparo Villablanca
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7bwhipe

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize mice using an intraperitoneal injection of 50 mg pentobarbital/kg weight.

steps.title: Perfuse Aortas
steps.instruction: Immediately after sacrifice, vent and nick the heart, then perfuse aortas with phosphate-buffered saline to remove blood.

steps.title: Excise and Fix Aortas
steps.instruction: Carefully remove periadventitial fat, excise the aortas, and fix them overnight using 4% followed by 10% paraformaldehyde.

steps.title: Segment Aortas
steps.instruction: Cut the fixed aortas into three segments (or specific desired segments such as the coronary sinus or the area between the aortic arch and aortic valve).

substeps.instruction: Proximal segment: include all of the aortic arch
Midsegment: include thoracic and suprarenal aorta
Distal segment: include infrarenal aorta proximal to the iliac bifurcation

steps.title: Embed and Store Tissues
steps.instruction: Place aortic segments side-by-side in cryomolds with optimum cutting temperature (OCT) compound, freeze on dry ice, and store at -80ºC.

steps.title: Section Tissues
steps.instruction: Section tissues using a microtome cryostat (HM 500 M) at -30°C to a thickness of 10 µm, discarding every other section.

substeps.instruction: Place four sections per slide for a total of 9 slides
Collect 36 sections per segment (108 cryosections per aorta)
Ensure a total of 360 µm from each segment and 1,000 µm from each aorta

steps.title: Stain Cryosections
steps.instruction: Stain the cryosections with oil-red-O and Gill’s hematoxylin.

substeps.instruction: Use oil-red-O to define and characterize neutral lipid in the vessel wall
Use Gill’s hematoxylin for histological assessment of lesions in artery segments

steps.title: Image and Analyze Lesions
steps.instruction: Analyze lesion location and area via direct imaging using an Olympus BX-40 microscope with a DP11 camera and smart media chip.

steps.title: Quantify Atheromas
steps.instruction: Identify atheromas using a single observer blinded to experimental parameters and determine the mean lesion area (µm² ± SE) using Image Pro Plus (version 4.1) computer-assisted imaging system.

substeps.instruction: Express atheroma distribution as a percentage of lesions per segment

steps.title: Perform Morphologic Assessment
steps.instruction: Perform qualitative morphologic assessment of lesion complexity and severity using light microscopy, classifying the stage of lesions according to the classification of Stary.

substeps.instruction: Assess for absence or presence of foam cells
